description: USFS Motor Vehicle Use Map roads + trails — the legal-designation layer. Per-vehicle-class allowance flags and parsed season windows baked into tile attributes; open/closed evaluated client-side against device date (works offline).
stable_key: source_id (= rte_cn; route numbers repeat across forests, CN does not)
notes: Seasonal dates are scheduled seasons, NOT live gate status. The printed MVUM PDF is the legal document of record — client must show the disclaimer.
enrichment: Trail features are enriched at build time from Trans_Trail_NFS_Publish (normalize_nfs_trails.py --attrs-out sidecar joined by CN via normalize_mvum.py --nfs-attrs): missing surface/trail_class are filled from the NFS Trails inventory. Best-effort — sidecar failure warns and builds unenriched. Season-field name variants handled: the bulk/live EDW data drops 'inches' in gt50/lt50 datesopen columns and uses *_dur for e-bikes (see lib/fixtures/datesopen_corpus.json field_resolution).
